title: Rajasthan, unhurried
tagline: Udaipur, Deogarh and Jodhpur at the pace they were built for.
overview: Courtyards in the morning, dunes at the end. Eight nights across Mewar and Marwar, moving slowly enough that the afternoons stay yours.
highlights: Two nights in a working fort in the Aravallis
Mehrangarh before the crowds arrive
A private desert camp, not a tourist one

itinerary.label: Day 01
itinerary.title: Arrive Udaipur
itinerary.text: Met at the airport, then straight to the lake. Nothing scheduled after — the first evening is yours.

itinerary.label: Day 02
itinerary.title: The City Palace, early
itinerary.text: Doors at 9:30, and we are there at 9:25. Afternoon free. Sunset crossing to Jagmandir.

itinerary.label: Day 03 – 04
itinerary.title: Deogarh
itinerary.text: Three hours north into the Aravallis. Two nights in a working fort and a village walk.

itinerary.label: Day 05 – 06
itinerary.title: Jodhpur
itinerary.text: Mehrangarh at opening, the old city on foot late afternoon, rooftop dinner facing the fort.

itinerary.label: Day 07 – 08
itinerary.title: Into the dunes, then home
itinerary.text: An afternoon drive out to camp, dinner under the sky, morning transfer to the airport.

stays: Thar — private desert camp, en-suite tent, 2 nights
meals: Four dinners including the rooftop and desert nights
One cooking afternoon with a Marwari home cook
Lunches left open — we will tell you where to go

title: The Golden Triangle
tagline: Delhi, Agra and Jaipur — done properly, not quickly.
overview: The classic route, timed against the crowds rather than with them. Early monuments, unhurried afternoons, and the old cities on foot.
highlights: The Taj at sunrise, before the gates crowd
Fatehpur Sikri on the road, not as a detour
Block-printing with a working Jaipur studio

itinerary.label: Day 01
itinerary.title: Arrive Delhi
itinerary.text: Airport pickup and an evening walk through Nizamuddin if you have the energy.

itinerary.label: Day 02
itinerary.title: Old and New Delhi
itinerary.text: Jama Masjid, a rickshaw through Chandni Chowk, and Humayun's Tomb at golden hour.

itinerary.label: Day 03
itinerary.title: To Agra
itinerary.text: Drive down by expressway. Mehtab Bagh at sunset for the view across the river.

itinerary.label: Day 04
itinerary.title: The Taj at sunrise, then Jaipur
itinerary.text: At the east gate before it opens. Fatehpur Sikri on the way to Jaipur.

itinerary.label: Day 05
itinerary.title: Jaipur
itinerary.text: Amber Fort early, the Pink City on foot, and a block-printing afternoon.

itinerary.label: Day 06
itinerary.title: Home
itinerary.text: Morning at leisure, transfer to Jaipur or Delhi airport.

title: Kashmir

The Lidder valley on foot
Wazwan cooked at home, not in a banquet hall

itinerary.label: Day 02

Two nights of nothing at all, on purpose

itinerary.label: Day 05 – 06
